### Godly Wisdom (No Special Sunglasses Required)
Author: Jessica Brodie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wholly-loved/godly-wisdom-no-special-sunglasses-required-wholly-loved-april-22.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 2:16
Points:
- Human intelligence, education, and reason are incapable of grasping God's wisdom on their own.
- The gospel reveals truths far beyond ordinary human perception and imagination.
- When believers receive the Holy Spirit, they are given spiritual vision to perceive divine truth.
- Through Christ dwelling within us, believers share in the very mind of Christ.

### The Blessedness No One Has Imagined
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-blessedness-no-one-has-imagined
Passage: 1 Corinthians 2:9-10
Points:
- God has prepared eternal rewards that completely exceed human observation and imagination.
- The Holy Spirit reveals the reality of these glorious blessings to believers through faith.
- Although believers taste these promises now, their complete fulfillment is yet to come.
- Direct, unhindered fellowship with God will be humanity's ultimate, everlasting joy.
